events.name: Bash
events.head: Check what exists on disk for the hand-off, probe and Instantly references
events.input: $ git branch --show-current && git log --oneline -8 -- workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md cloud/src/agentic.ts cloud/src/jobs.ts | cat; echo ---; git branch -a --contains bb11531 2>&1 | head; echo ---; git status --short -- workshop-plan/ops cloud/src cloud/scripts | head; echo ---; git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main; echo ---; cat workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py; echo ---; grep -rn -i "endy_leads\|ENDY_LEAD_EMAIL" --include=*.py --include=*.ts --include=*.sh --include=*.md --include=*.toml --include=

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find where the hand-off is invoked, read the probe, find related tasks
events.input: $ grep -rn -i "endy_leads\|ENDY_LEAD_EMAIL" . --include='*.py' --include='*.ts' --include='*.sh' --include='*.toml' --include='*.plist' --include='*.mjs' --include='*.md' 2>/dev/null | grep -v "node_modules\|tasks/activity\|/decisions/" | cut -c1-200 | head -30; echo ---PROBE; cat cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs | head -60; echo ---TASKS; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read sheet sync scheduling, the warmup job on main and on the T-299 branch, and pass.py commands
events.input: $ sed -n 205,250p workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py; echo ---SCHED; grep -rn "centre_sheet" --include='*.py' --include='*.sh' --include='*.plist' --include='*.json' --include='*.toml' --include='*.ts' . ~/Library/LaunchAgents 2>/dev/null | grep -v "node_modules\|tasks/activity\|tasks.json\|^./workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py\|endy_leads.py" | cut -c1-220 | head; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -i "centre\|sheet" | cut -c1-200; echo ---WARMUP; a=$(grep -n "async function warmup(x: Ctx)" cloud/src/jobs.ts | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "${a},$((a+45))p" cloud/src/jobs.ts | cut -c1-260; echo ---T299; git

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check the scheduled sheet sync job, the checkout it runs from, and how tasks are added
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/ops/launchd/com.tantra.centre-sheet.plist | grep -v "^<?xml\|DOCTYPE" | head -40; diff -q workshop-plan/ops/launchd/com.tantra.centre-sheet.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.centre-sheet.plist; launchctl list | grep -i centre-sheet; O=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2; echo ---OTHER; git -C $O remote get-url origin 2>&1 | sed 's#//[^@]*@#//#'; git -C $O branch --show-current; git -C $O log --oneline -1 | cat; ls -la $O/workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py $O/workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads_sent.json 2>&1 | cut -c1-160; grep -n "endy" $O/workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the sync log, the other checkout's state and the token's scopes (no secret values)
events.input: $ O=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2; tail -8 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | cut -c1-300; ls -la /tmp/centre-sheet.log; date; echo ---; git -C $O status --short | head -5; git -C $O log -1 --format='%h %ci' | cat; git merge-base --is-ancestor $(git -C $O rev-parse HEAD) main && echo "onboarding-v2 HEAD is in main" || echo "onboarding-v2 HEAD NOT in main"; git -C $O rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main 2>/dev/null; echo ---diff; diff <(git -C $O show HEAD:workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py) workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py | head -60 | cut -c1-200; echo ---; grep -rn "tantra-onboarding-v2" work

events.name: Bash
events.head: Dry-run the sheet sync from main and identify the sending mailbox
events.input: $ grep -n "written\|new lead" /tmp/centre-sheet.log | tail -3; grep -c "401" /tmp/centre-sheet.log; grep -n "401" /tmp/centre-sheet.log | head -1; echo ---DRY; /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3 workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py --dry 2>&1 | tail -12 | cut -c1-200; echo ---PROFILE; /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the Tantra accounts check and the runbook lines about the sync job
events.input: $ grep -rn "export async function tantraMailboxes" -A 14 cloud/src | cut -c1-230 | head -24; echo ---; sed -n 33,36p workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-260; sed -n 45,48p workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-400; echo ---; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/src/jobs.ts | grep -n "async function warmup\|Connected and Gmail capable\|tantraMailboxes" | head; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/src/agentic.ts | grep -n -i instantly | head -5; git check-ignore -v workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads_sent.json | head -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare where the start-endy wait lives on main and on the T-299 branch
events.input: $ git grep -n -i "tantraMailboxes\|start-endy\|Gmail capable" t-299-vendor-inboxes -- cloud/src | cut -c1-240 | head -20; echo ---MAIN; git grep -n -i "start-endy\|tantraMailboxes" main -- cloud/src | cut -c1-200 | head -12; echo; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs | diff - cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the probe, the hand-off script and the T-299 branch warm-up check
events.input: $ cat cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs; echo =====; cat workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py; echo =====; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/src/agentic.ts | sed -n 274,296p | cut -c1-260; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/src/agentic.ts | grep -n -i "instantly" | cut -c1-160 | head; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/src/jobs.ts | grep -n -i "instantly\|warmup" | cut -c1-160 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the hand-off script and the T-299 branch warm-up check
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py; echo "#####"; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/src/agentic.ts | sed -n 274,296p | cut -c1-260; echo "#####"; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/src/agentic.ts | grep -n -i "instantly" | cut -c1-160 | head; echo "#####"; git show t-299-vendor-inboxes:cloud/src/jobs.ts | grep -n -i "instantly\|warmup" | cut -c1-160 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the probe on main and on the T-299 branch export; find the task add command
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs; echo "exit $?"; T=$(mktemp -d) && git archive t-299-vendor-inboxes cloud/src | tar -x -C $T && echo "--- t-299 branch" && SRC=$T/cloud/src node cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs; echo "exit $?"; rm -rf $T; grep -n "pass.py add\|\"add\"\|== 'add'\|def _add" -A3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rewrite the hand-off script's send and test paths, then read the sync hook, plist and call brief lines

events.name: Bash
events.head: Point the scheduled sheet sync at this checkout, arm the test lead, and reload the job
events.input: $ L=~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.centre-sheet.plist && R=workshop-plan/ops/launchd/com.tantra.centre-sheet.plist && cp $L /tmp/com.tantra.centre-sheet.plist.before-T213 && sed -i '' 's#/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2#/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign#g' $R && cp $R $L && plutil -lint $L && /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3 workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py --arm && wc -l < /tmp/centre-sheet.log && launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.centre-sheet; launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) $L && launchctl kickstart gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.centre-sheet; l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the scheduled run's log lines, the call brief and the runbook rows
events.input: $ sleep 20; tail -n +5211 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | cut -c1-200; echo "#### brief"; cat workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md | cut -c1-600; echo "#### runbook"; sed -n 35p workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-500; sed -n 45,48p workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-500
